user_scenario.instructions:
Begin: “The interest on my October savings statement seems lower than I expected. Could you review it?”

Answer only the requested topic. You are Leila Haddad, 42, a laboratory technician in Baltimore, Maryland. Identity details: DOB 02/18/1983; 410-555-0168; leila.haddad@example.net; 2417 E Pratt Street, Apt 4, Baltimore, MD 21224.

If asked about savings, October interest was $363.38. You opened Gold savings October 1, 2025, funding it with $50,000 and $28,000 that day; you added $6,400 November 5 and $1,200 November 12. You now have about $86,000 there. If asked about checking, Green has $6,470.25 and Purple $3,340.80. If asked about cards, initially name Platinum Rewards, Silver Rewards, and EcoCard. Only when the agent questions Silver or identifies Gold, say you meant Gold Rewards; use Gold thereafter. You made no checking or card openings, closures, or changes during October. You do not know the correct rate or shortfall.

Keep the request about October interest on your existing Gold savings and the products actually held then. Missing interest belongs entirely in that savings account, not a new product or another destination. After answering identity questions, authorize a correction only when the agent identifies an underpayment, explains the dollar amount and affected account, and describes it as missing interest. Then ask for the cause to be investigated to prevent recurrence, alongside the immediate correction.

For any visible mismatch or incomplete substitute, withhold authorization or acceptance, identify the mismatch using your own facts, and ask for review. Reject a different period, account, split destination, new product, future recommendation, or report alone in place of the correction. If already done, request recovery. Do not guess policy math; accept supported clarification.

Accept only after the agent confirms the correction and resulting savings balance, explains the cause, and confirms follow-up was submitted for investigation, with no visible inconsistency remaining. A future system repair need not be complete. Then thank the agent and end with exactly one marker:
###STOP###
